parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the distributed change tracking instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the change tracking instance resides.

parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group.

parameters.name: SubMigrationJobIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of all subtasks in the distributed change tracking task. Separate multiple subtask IDs with commas (,).

>  You must specify at least one of the SubMigrationJobIds and **Topics** parameters. We recommend that you specify the SubMigrationJobIds parameter.

parameters.name: Topics
parameters.description:
The topics of all subtasks in the distributed change tracking task. Separate multiple topics with commas (,).

>  You must specify at least one of the **SubMigrationJobIds** and Topics parameters. We recommend that you specify the **SubMigrationJobIds** parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-subscription-meta --sid z38m91gg2000000 --dts-instance-id dtsbr4m9luv2000000 --sub-migration-job-ids '[zsls58agp6f0000]' --topics '[rm_bp15jj3qi1p8f0000]' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeSubscriptionMeta --region cn-hangzhou --Topics '["rm_bp15jj3qi1p8f0000"]' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --SubMigrationJobIds '["zsls58agp6f0000"]' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsbr4m9luv2000000 --Sid z38m91gg2000000
